questions.question: How do I track the garbage truck today?
steps: Open the MUC Digital platform on your mobile app or web browser.
Access the Real Time Garbage Collection System module.
View the live maps to track the garbage truck's exact location using its GPS hardware.

questions.question: How will I know when the garbage truck is near my house?
steps: Ensure you have the MUC Digital mobile application downloaded and installed.
Keep your app notifications enabled.
The system will automatically send you a notification when a garbage truck approaches your location.

questions.question: How can I find out if today's collection is for degradable or non-degradable waste?
steps: Open the MUC Digital app.
Navigate to the Real Time Garbage Collection System.
Check the truck's status, which will display whether it is currently collecting degradable or non-degradable waste.

questions.question: How do I find the closest place to dump my waste?
steps: Open the MUC Digital platform.
Select the nearest dumping point locator tool.
View the map integration to locate the exact dumping point closest to you.

questions.question: How do I report illegal garbage dumping in my area?
steps: Open the MUC Digital application.
Go to the illegal dumping point reporting system.
Take photos of the location and use the image upload feature to submit your report to the council.

questions.question: How do I schedule a special waste pickup?
steps: Open the MUC Digital platform.
Navigate to the waste pickup scheduling system.
Submit your request so the council can schedule your special waste pickup.

questions.question: How do I book a public ground or hall?
steps: Access the Online Booking System for Council Properties & Vehicles on the platform.
Select the specific public property you want to reserve, such as a ground or hall.
Submit your booking request online.
Wait for the council administrators to digitally approve or reject your booking.

questions.question: How do I check if a council vehicle or equipment is available to rent?
steps: Go to the Online Booking System section.
Choose the council vehicle or equipment you need.
View the screen to see real-time availability and pricing.

questions.question: How do I make a payment for my public property booking?
steps: Submit your booking request for the property or vehicle.
Review the real-time pricing displayed for your selection.
Proceed to checkout and make your payment online using the integrated payment gateway.

questions.question: How do I book a crematorium or cemetery slot?
steps: Go to the Cemetery & Crematorium Reservation System in the app.
Browse the available slots, dates, and times.
Submit your details for verification to check eligibility criteria.
Make your reservation payment directly through the system.

questions.question: How will I know if my crematorium booking is confirmed?
steps: Complete your reservation and payment in the Cemetery & Crematorium Reservation System.
The system will immediately provide an instant confirmation.
Download or view the digital receipt provided for your booking.

questions.question: How do I quickly call the Police in an emergency?
steps: Open the MUC Digital mobile application.
Go to the Emergency One Tap Access module.
Tap on the 'Police' option, and the system will instantly initiate the call with a single tap.

questions.question: How do I request an Ambulance through the app?
steps: Open the MUC Digital app.
Navigate to the Emergency One Tap Access section.
Tap the 'Ambulance' option to make an immediate call without needing to search for the phone number.

questions.question: How do I contact the Fire Brigade?
steps: Open the app and locate the Emergency One Tap Access feature.
Select the 'Firebrigade' option.
The call will be initiated immediately with just one tap.

questions.question: How can I get help from Disaster Management?
steps: Launch the MUC Digital application.
Access the Emergency One Tap Access module.
Choose 'Disaster Management' to make an instant emergency call.

questions.question: How do I find out about scheduled water cuts?
steps: Keep the MUC Digital app installed on your smartphone.
Council administrators will publish urgent alerts or announcements regarding water cuts.
You will instantly receive a push notification to your phone with the alert details.

questions.question: How can I stay updated on dengue fogging schedules?
steps: Ensure your device can receive notifications from the MUC Digital app.
The council administrators will publish general announcements about dengue fogging schedules.
The system will alert you via an instant push notification.

questions.question: How do I get information on shramadhana campaigns or municipal events?
steps: Check the unified Announcements section on the platform.
Look for general announcements published by the council.
You can also rely on instant push notifications sent to your phone about these events.

questions.question: How do I submit a general complaint to the urban council?
steps: Access the MUC Digital mobile or web application.
Navigate to the complaints and requests submission section.
Submit your complaint directly through the platform for the council to review.

questions.question: What if I need fast help with navigating the app or reporting an issue?
steps: Open the MUC Digital app.
Access the Smart Chatbot Assistance feature.
Interact with the 24/7 intelligent chatbot to get fast responses to FAQs or receive step-by-step guidance.
